f1-lights-out.title: F1 Lights Out
f1-lights-out.description: Watch the five red lights go out, then tap as close to that moment as you can. Tap too early and you jump-start — 0 points!

stack-the-blocks.title: Stack the Blocks
stack-the-blocks.description: Tap to drop each sliding block onto the stack. Overhang gets sliced off, so stay precise and build the tower as high as you can.

whack-a-mole.title: Whack-a-Mole
whack-a-mole.description: Moles pop up from their holes — tap them before they duck back down. Chain hits together for combo bonuses.

lane-swipe-runner.title: Lane-Swipe Runner
lane-swipe-runner.description: Swipe left or right (or use the arrow keys or A and D) to steer your car between lanes and dodge the traffic. The longer you survive, the faster it gets — the farthest distance wins.

maze-ball-drag.title: Maze Ball Drag
maze-ball-drag.description: Drag the ball through the maze to the exit, or steer it with the arrow keys or WASD. Pick up coins for bonus points, but be quick — every second costs points, and a hole costs you time and sets you back.

simon-says-colors.title: Simon-Says Color Sequence
simon-says-colors.description: Repeat the growing pattern of colored squares in the right order. One wrong tap ends the round.

card-flip-matching.title: Card-Flip Matching
card-flip-matching.description: Flip two cards at a time to find matching pairs. Fewer flips and a faster time earn a better score.

balloon-pop-precision.title: Balloon Pop Precision
balloon-pop-precision.description: Pop balloons the instant they appear for a perfect hit. Timing accuracy boosts your score multiplier.

bomb-defusal.title: Bomb Defusal
bomb-defusal.description: Read the manual, then defuse the module before the timer runs out. More modules mean more to juggle at once.
